Criteria:
- P1: Dependencies: does every step come after the steps whose results it needs? If a requirement of step B uses something that a requirement of step A creates (a name, a command, a connection, data, a schema, a part that is reused), B needs A. Name each missing dependency as 'A -> B' (A must finish before B) and say what B needs from A.
- P2: Coverage: is each requirement's work done by build and test steps that really do it?
- P3: Acceptance criteria: are they concrete and checkable?
- P4: Granularity: no duplicated steps and no step split into trivial pieces?

The research, verify, design and review steps and the order research -> design -> build -> test -> documents -> review come from a template and are correct. Steps listed as 'after: X' already depend on X (directly); a dependency through other steps also counts.

Material:
Requirements:
R1 [must] The web app must let users register with an email address.
R2 [must] Users must be able to reset their password by email.
R3 [should] The app should be deployed to AWS.
R4 [must] Demonstrate the working app to your TA in person during week 8.
R5 [must] Upload the final ZIP to Moodle before the deadline.
R6 [must] Passwords must be stored hashed.

Plan steps:
research [research] Research the approach (requirements: -; after: -) criteria: every research question has an answer with sources; the answers name the options considered
verify [research] Check the research findings (requirements: -; after: research) criteria: every claim the design uses is supported by a source; unsupported claims are marked
design [design] Design the solution (requirements: -; after: verify) criteria: each part has a module and an interface; the skeleton runs; the design follows the constraints; C1 respected: Use Django 5.
T1 [implement] Implement user registration (requirements: R1; after: design) criteria: R1: The web app must let users register with an email address.
T5 [implement] Implement: The app should be deployed to AWS (requirements: R3; after: design) criteria: R3: The app should be deployed to AWS.
T2 [implement] Implement password reset with hashing (requirements: R2, R6; after: T1) criteria: R2: Users must be able to reset their password by email.; R6: Passwords must be stored hashed.
T3 [test] Test user registration flow (requirements: R1; after: T1) criteria: R1: The web app must let users register with an email address.
T6 [test] Check: The app should be deployed to AWS (requirements: R3; after: T5) criteria: R3 works as stated
T4 [test] Test password reset and hashing (requirements: R2, R6; after: T2) criteria: R2: Users must be able to reset their password by email.; R6: Passwords must be stored hashed.
T7 [document] Prepare User guide (requirements: -; after: T3, T4, T6) criteria: D2 exists: User guide as PDF; it matches the finished, tested work
review [review] Final review (requirements: -; after: T7) criteria: every must requirement is met; every deliverable is present; C1 respected: Use Django 5.; D1 handed in: Source code ZIP (zip)

Requirements a person must do (not planned on purpose): R4, R5
